meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 先宣布 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!,把你的规划请求复述一遍,再组织 5 名互相敌对的评审成员互相批驳方案;只保留经受住攻击的要点,最后强制地把结论交给 plan 代理,由它生成正式的可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出「hyperplan」「hpp」等触发词,或要求对抗式/敌意式/交叉评审式规划、或需要极高严谨度、暴露薄弱假设、盲点与过度设计时触发;需团队模式开启、有主导权角色在主会话运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划 Q3 的产品路线图
say.note: 会先复述需求,再进入 7 阶段对抗式评审。

say.text: 对我的方案来一轮 hostile planning,专挑薄弱假设
say.note: 五个评审成员互相批驳,只留经得起攻击的结论。

say.text: 把这个计划输入 hpp,重点看看有没有过度设计
say.note: skeptic 会专门打击复杂化和多余功能。

howto.what_en: Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", restates your ask, leads 5 mutually hostile subagents to cross-critique it, keeps only surviving insights, and hands them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "hyperplan", "hpp", adversarial/hostile/cross-critique requests, or high-rigor planning. Needs team mode enabled, lead-eligible role, main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to help me plan this project.
say_en.note: Claude restates the request and runs the 7-phase adversarial review.

say_en.text: Run hostile planning on my proposal and find weak assumptions.
say_en.note: The five hostile members cross-critique; only solid points survive.

say_en.text: Feed this plan through hpp and check for over-engineering.
say_en.note: Skeptic attacks extra complexity and gold-plating.
